items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH’s Board appointed Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO, effective July 13, 2026, while recruitment continued for a permanent President and CEO.

items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: In announcing Pierre Noel’s interim appointment, ARH thanked Raeline McGrath for serving as Acting President and CEO “during the few weeks” following the preceding CEO transition, while she continued as Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive.

items.citation_text: Public Statement: Jeremy Stevenson steps down as President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH announced that Jeremy Stevenson stepped down from the President and CEO role on June 2, 2026.

items.role: Chief of Staff (joint model with QCH)
items.citation_text: ARH media releases: ARH and QCH to implement joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH and Queensway Carleton Hospital announced a joint Chief of Staff model and appointed QCH Chief of Staff Dr. Kathi Kovacs to the ARH role, effective August 1, 2025.

items.citation_text: Board announces new CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Following what ARH described as a comprehensive and competitive recruitment process, the Board selected Jeremy Stevenson as the next President and CEO.

items.citation_text: ARH Board of Directors appoints new Chair
items.verbatim_snippet: Following the 2024 Annual General Meeting, the Board appointed Oliver Jacob as Board Chair for a three-year term ending in June 2027.

items.citation_text: ARH Board of Directors appoints new Chair
items.verbatim_snippet: Cathy Jordan completed three years as Chair, including her final year in the position, and moved from the Chair role while continuing as a member of the Board.

items.citation_text: Leah Levesque to retire June 2024
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH’s July 2024 Board-chair announcement described Leah Levesque as its “newly retired” President and CEO.

items.citation_text: Leah Levesque to Retire June 2024
items.verbatim_snippet: Board Chair Cathy Jordan announced that President and CEO Leah Levesque had advised the Board of her intention to retire in late June 2024.

items.verbatim_snippet: ARH celebrated Barb Darlow as an outgoing director. She joined the Board in 2013, served as Chair from 2015 to 2021 and remained a director until June 2022.

items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
items.verbatim_snippet: Leah Levesque officially began leading ARH on October 1, 2021.

items.citation_text: Eric Hanna: Retiring after 13 years at the helm of ARH
items.verbatim_snippet: Eric Hanna’s final day at ARH was September 30, 2021, concluding 13 years as President and CEO and a 35-year career in health-care leadership.

items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH’s Board announced that it had appointed Leah Levesque as the organization’s next President and CEO, succeeding Eric Hanna.
